overview.summary: Bosch web banners can be animated when the animation remains brand-compliant, purposeful, and performance-aware.
overview.guideline_context: The guideline addresses aspects relevant for brand-compliant animation in Bosch web banners.

covered_animation_aspects.description: Create transitions such as fade-out, slide-in, bounce-in, and scale effects.
Control the speed of elements that appear within the banner.
Integrate sound only when it strongly supports the general concept.

sound_guidance.reason: Sound would need to be activated by the user first.
sound_guidance.rule: Avoid sound in display campaigns unless it is essential and user activation is planned.

behavior.principle: Animation and motion within a banner can increase user engagement when used subtly and purposefully.
benefits: Subtle transitions and motion effects draw attention.
risks: Excessive animation can lead to a loss of user focus.
Animations increase file size and can limit performance.

recommendations.rule: Limit duration to a non-looped 10-20 seconds.
recommendations.rationale: Animations increase file size and can limit performance.

recommendations.rule: Use animation to support the call-to-action (CTA).
recommendations.rationale: The animation should clearly state what to do next.
Non-linear motion creates a more natural look.

variants.name: Variant 1
variants.principle: Rolling shutter principle with top-to-bottom fade-in effects.
variants.intro: The advised order for an animated banner ad follows a staged reveal from base brand elements to image, headline, subline, and CTA.

steps.state: Supergraphic, symbol/logotype and slogan are visible. Base layer fills the entire format.
Image appears beneath the base layer and moves from bottom to top into the Experience Area.
Headline appears into the base layer.
steps.motion: Headline fades in from top to bottom.
Subline fades in from top to bottom.

steps.state: Primary Button appears beneath the subline, concluding the reveal sequence. This final state is then shown in loop.
steps.motion: CTA fades in from top to bottom.

variants.name: Variant 2
variants.principle: Zoom-out principle with top-to-bottom fade-in effects.
variants.intro: The animation starts with a zoomed-in image in the Experience Area, then creates white space for the base layer before introducing text and CTA elements.

steps.state: Supergraphic, symbol/logotype and slogan are visible on the base layer. Within the Experience Area, the image is zoomed out.
After the zoom-out, both the Experience Area and image are smaller. The Experience Area fills its initial format, creating white space for the base layer.
Headline appears after the zoom-out transition.
steps.motion: Headline fades in from top to bottom.
Subline fades in from top to bottom.

steps.state: Primary Button appears beneath the subline, concluding the sequence. This final state is then shown in loop.
steps.motion: CTA fades in from top to bottom.

primary_rules: Use animation to support communication and CTA clarity, not as decoration only.
Prefer subtle, purposeful motion over excessive animation.
Avoid linear motion to create a more natural behavior.
Respect performance constraints caused by animation file size.
Avoid sound for display campaigns unless user activation is explicitly planned.

recommended_duration.looping: non-looped duration recommended; final state may be shown in loop according to variant descriptions

sequence_pattern: image reveal or image zoom transition
